name: io.github.Free-cat/telegram-ads-mcp
description: Read and manage Telegram Ads campaigns by driving ads.telegram.org with Playwright.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ADS_AUTH_STATE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to the saved Playwright session file created by `telegram-ads-auth`.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ADS_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Substring match on the account name to manage. Required when the login has more than one account.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ADS_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to refuse every state-changing tool, leaving only the read-only tools.

environmentVariables.name: TELEGRAM_ADS_MAX_SPEND_TON
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling, in TON, on any single budget-increasing call.
